repositoryMemory.title: OpenWiki repository memory
repositoryMemory.description: Auto-merge updates openwiki/ in its integration candidate. Standalone updates and initial generation require an explicit request and use a dedicated workspace; publication and pending changes never start one automatically. Initial generation receives an independent read-only review and optional refinement before publication. Coding workspaces read the Wiki and keep their own Workspace Memory.

ask_for_approval.description:
Determines when the user is consulted to approve Codex actions.

- `UnlessTrusted`: Read-only commands are auto-approved. Everything else will
  ask the user to approve.
- `OnRequest`: The model decides when to ask the user for approval.
- `Never`: Commands never ask for approval. Commands that fail in the
  restricted sandbox are not retried.

execution_mode.description:
How an interactive coding request should be executed.

This is intentionally separate from [`PermissionPolicy`]: planning and
long-running goal execution describe workflow, while permission policy
describes what the provider may do without asking.
